name: SV Annotation & Classification
nameZH: 结构变异注释与致病性评估
overview: 基于 AnnotSV 的结构变异注释与致病性分级流程，覆盖 >20 个注释数据库（ClinVar/ClinGen/OMIM/gnomAD 等），支持 ACMG/ClinGen 五级致病性分类、HPO 表型驱动优先级排序和 SNV 交叉验证假阳性过滤。
overviewEn: AnnotSV-based SV annotation and pathogenicity classification pipeline covering >20 annotation databases (ClinVar/ClinGen/OMIM/gnomAD etc.), supporting ACMG/ClinGen 5-tier classification, HPO-driven prioritization, and SNV cross-validation false-positive filtering.

steps.name: 安装与注释库下载
steps.description: 源码安装 AnnotSV v3.5.10 并下载人类注释数据库
steps.descriptionEn: Install AnnotSV v3.5.10 from source and download human annotation databases

tools.name: git clone + make
tools.params: make PREFIX=. install && make PREFIX=. install-human-annotation
tools.notes: conda 安装需单独运行 INSTALL_annotations.sh 下载注释库。
tools.notesEn: Conda install requires separate annotation download via INSTALL_annotations.sh.

steps.notes: 推荐源码安装，注释库自动下载。conda 安装需额外指定 -annotationsDir。
steps.notesEn: Source install recommended, annotations auto-downloaded. Conda install requires manual -annotationsDir.

steps.name: SV 注释
steps.description: 对 SV VCF/BED 进行多数据库注释，生成 TSV 注释表
steps.descriptionEn: Multi-database annotation of SV VCF/BED, producing TSV annotation table

tools.name: AnnotSV
tools.notes: 支持 VCF/BED 输入，输出 TSV/HTML/VCF/XLSM。Full 模式每 SV 一行，Split 模式每基因一行。
tools.notesEn: Supports VCF/BED input, outputs TSV/HTML/VCF/XLSM. Full mode: one row per SV; Split mode: one row per gene per SV.

steps.notesEn: Covers >20 databases: ClinVar, ClinGen, OMIM, gnomAD, dbVar, DGV etc.

steps.name: 表型优先级排序
steps.description: 基于 HPO 术语对 SV 进行表型驱动的优先级排序

tools.name: AnnotSV -hpo
tools.notes: Exomiser 引擎，推荐 score > 0.7。可同时传入多个 HPO 术语。
tools.notesEn: Exomiser engine, recommend score > 0.7. Multiple HPO terms supported.

steps.notes: HPO 术语驱动 Exomiser 引擎进行表型-基因型关联排序。
steps.notesEn: HPO terms drive Exomiser engine for phenotype-genotype association ranking.

steps.name: 假阳性过滤
steps.description: 利用 SNV/indel 数据交叉验证 SV 真实性

tools.name: AnnotSV -snvIndelFiles
tools.notes: 大缺失区域若出现杂合 SNV 提示假阳性。
tools.notesEn: Heterozygous SNVs in large deletion regions indicate potential false positives.

steps.notes: 检测大缺失区域杂合 SNV，假阳性 SV 标记过滤。
steps.notesEn: Detect heterozygous SNVs in large deletion regions, flag false-positive SVs.

steps.name: ACMG/ClinGen 致病性分级
steps.description: 自动计算 ACMG/ClinGen 五级致病性评分（Class 1-5）

tools.name: AnnotSV 自动 ranking
tools.notes: Class 5 (>=0.99) 致病, Class 4 (0.90-0.98) 可能致病, Class 3 VUS, Class 2 可能良性, Class 1 (<=-0.99) 良性。
tools.notesEn: Class 5 (>=0.99) pathogenic, Class 4 (0.90-0.98) likely pathogenic, Class 3 VUS, Class 2 likely benign, Class 1 (<=-0.99) benign.

steps.notes: 基于 Riggs et al. 2020 (Genetics in Medicine) ACMG/ClinGen 联合共识标准。
steps.notesEn: Based on Riggs et al. 2020 (Genetics in Medicine) ACMG/ClinGen consensus recommendations.

steps.name: 结果过滤与输出
steps.description: 提取致病/可能致病 SV（Class 4-5），输出多种格式结果
steps.descriptionEn: Extract pathogenic/likely pathogenic SVs (Class 4-5), output in multiple formats

tools.name: AnnotSV -rankFiltering
tools.notes: 输出 TSV/HTML/VCF/XLSM 多格式，HTML 含交互式 knotAnnotSV 可视化。
tools.notesEn: Output TSV/HTML/VCF/XLSM formats, HTML includes interactive knotAnnotSV visualization.

steps.notes: 仅保留 Class 4-5，输出交互式 HTML 用于临床审核。
steps.notesEn: Keep only Class 4-5, output interactive HTML for clinical review.
